verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com. Its tools cover API search, read and write, analytics, and documentation search, and connections use OAuth or a restricted API key, with session revocation, admin controls, human confirmation for risky writes, and tool-call logs. Official plugins install it into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and a live probe confirms the endpoint is up and OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec.
